Id: TrustDemoDT05
Url: TD.DT.05 Does the portal release the manifest for this request?
Version: 0.1.0
Title: TD.DT.05 Does the portal release the manifest for this request?
Status: draft
Experimental: true
Type:

system: http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/plan-definition-type

code: eca-rule

Date: 2026-11-05 14:17:56+0000
Publisher: litlfred
Description:

For one manifest request (ITI-YY5), decide whether the portal releases the manifest, and what the access log records. Requirements: STD-ACC-001. Hit policy FIRST: the rules are tried in order and the first that matches applies.
Related Artifacts:

Documentation

  • Decision table TD.DT.05 (OMG DMN 1.3): vhl-release.dmn
Actions:
Rule 1:

When withdrawn is true: release = false; auditOutcome = 4; refusalReason = withdrawn. STD-ACC-001 (revoke): a withdrawn link releases nothing; the attempt is logged.
Rule 2:

When withdrawn is false and withinPeriod is false: release = false; auditOutcome = 4; refusalReason = expired. STD-ACC-001 (expiry): a link opened outside the holder's period (J4: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-09, Consent TrustDemoJ4Consent) releases nothing.
Rule 3:

When withdrawn is false and withinPeriod is true and passcodeMatches is false: release = false; auditOutcome = 4; refusalReason = wrong-passcode. STD-ACC-001 (passcode): a wrong passcode releases nothing and is logged at home (AuditEvent TrustDemoJ41WrongPasscode).
Rule 4:

When withdrawn is false and withinPeriod is true and passcodeMatches is true: release = true; auditOutcome = 0. The manifest is released and the access logged (AuditEvent TrustDemoJ41Access).
